say:3:1320505001:1.text: Dura above, thank you all for bringing back this sheep.
say:3:1320505001:1.source_cn: 女神在上，感谢你们把这只羊送回来！

say:4:1320505002:1.text: I was going home, and then all the sheep I brought out today all ran away. I tried calling them back, but none of them listened. Then Sasha, my sheepdog, ran after them.
say:4:1320505002:1.source_cn: 我刚才正打算回家呢，可没想到今天带出来的几只羊全都跑远...

say:5:1320505003:1.text: I tried to go after them, but I couldn't keep up. My only choice was to wait here for Sasha to round them up.
say:5:1320505003:1.source_cn: 但我腿脚不方便，根本追不上它们，只能在这里等萨莎把它们...

say:6:1320505004:1.text: Where did you find this little one? Are there other sheep about?
say:6:1320505004:1.source_cn: 你们是在哪找到这只羊的？那附近还有没有别的羊？

choice_prompt:7:1320505004.text: Where did you find this little one? Are there other sheep about?
choice_prompt:7:1320505004.source_cn: 你们是在哪找到这只羊的？那附近还有没有别的羊？

say:8:1320505005:1.text: A sheepdog herded this one to us. That must've been Sasha.
say:8:1320505005:1.source_cn: 是一只狗把它赶到我们身边的。应该就是你说的萨莎吧？

say:9:1320505007:1.text: Yeah, that's my Sasha. She's very well-behaved and always sticks to the herd.
say:9:1320505007:1.source_cn: 噢，那肯定没错！我的萨莎很听话，会一直跟在羊群身边。

say:10:1320505008:1.text: If she didn't come back with you, it's probably because she went to find the other two sheep.
say:10:1320505008:1.source_cn: 既然它没跟着你们回来，估计是去找另外两只羊了。

say:11:1320505009:1.text: I think I heard a sheep to the <style="highlight">north</style>. Can you please help <style="highlight">bring that one back</style>?

say:12:1320505010:1.text: Alright, we'll go take a look.
say:12:1320505010:1.source_cn: 那好吧，我们会去看看的！

choice:7:0:1.text: We didn't see any other sheep.
choice:7:0:1.male: We didn't see any other sheep.
choice:7:0:1.female: We didn't see any other sheep.

say:14:1320505006:1.text: Yeah, she herded this one to us.
say:14:1320505006:1.source_cn: 嗯，是它把这只羊赶到我们身边的。
